<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>package_private</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>global.AdvancedSchedulerUtils</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description>Utilities for advanced scheduler fields</description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>AdvancedSchedulerUtils</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var AdvancedSchedulerUtils = Class.create();
AdvancedSchedulerUtils.prototype = {
	initialize: function() {},

	shiftToTZ: function(glideUtcDateTime, timeZoneAsString) {
		var gdt = new GlideDateTime();
		if (timeZoneAsString) {
			var success = gdt.setTimeZone(timeZoneAsString);
			if (!success) {
				return null;
			}
		}

		// GlideDateTime.setDisplayValue() needs the time in the user's format. We run this
		//  method to ensure getDisplayValue() is in the user's format (GlideUtcDateTime may
		//  return an internal format if the object attributes are not set correctly.)
		var utcGdt = new GlideDateTime();
		utcGdt.setTimeZone("UTC");
		utcGdt.setValue(glideUtcDateTime.getValue());

		// Set display time in user specified time zone
		gdt.setDisplayValue(utcGdt.getDisplayValue());
		return gdt;
	},

	//Update runDateTime based on enteredDateTime adjusted by timezone
	adjustToTimeZone: function(enteredDateTime, runDateTime, timeZone) {
		if (timeZone == '' || timeZone.equals("-- None --")) // if time zone has not been set there is nothing to adjust
			return;
		else if (enteredDateTime == '')
			runDateTime.setValue('');
        else if (timeZone.equals("floating") && enteredDateTime) {
			var gcdt = new GlideCalendarDateTime(enteredDateTime);
			gcdt.adjustFromFloatingTzToUTC();
			runDateTime.setValue(gcdt);
		} else {
			if (enteredDateTime) {
				var newRunDateTime = this.shiftToTZ(enteredDateTime, timeZone);
				runDateTime.setValue(newRunDateTime);
			}
		}
	},

	isTimeZoneValid: function(timeZoneAsString) {
		var gdt = new GlideDateTime();
		if (!timeZoneAsString || timeZoneAsString.equals('-- None --') || timeZoneAsString.equals('floating'))
			return true; //a missing timezone is a valid timezone, 'floating' is a valid timezone

		if (gdt.setTimeZone(timeZoneAsString))
			return true;
		else
			return false;
	},

	isNextActionInvalid: function(nextOccurrence, rawRunEnd) {
		var INVALID_DATETIME = new GlideDateTime("3000-02-03 00:00:00");
		if (nextOccurrence.equals(INVALID_DATETIME)) {
			gs.addErrorMessage(gs.getMessage("The provided values result in an invalid next occurrence. Review and modify the Ending field"));
			return true;
		}

		if (nextOccurrence.after(INVALID_DATETIME)) {
			gs.addErrorMessage(gs.getMessage("The calculated next occurrence is beyond the allowed range. Review and modify the Starting and Ending fields to submit the record."));
			return true;
		}

		if (rawRunEnd.isNil()) {
			// previous validation successful, future validation requires run_end
			return false;
		}

		var runEnd = (rawRunEnd instanceof GlideDateTime) ? rawRunEnd : rawRunEnd.getGlideObject();
		if (nextOccurrence.after(runEnd)) {
			gs.addErrorMessage(gs.getMessage("The calculated next occurrence is beyond the allowed range. Review and modify the Starting and Ending fields to submit the record."));
			return true;
		}

		if (runEnd.onOrBefore(gs.nowGlideDateTime())) {
			gs.addErrorMessage(gs.getMessage("Ending cannot be in the past. Set Ending to a date in the future to submit the record."));
			return true;
		}

		return false;
	},

	// directly set next occurrence for periodically jobs with no starting, on insert, or starting in the future
	getNextOccurrenceForPeriodically: function(sysautoGr) {
		var now = new GlideDateTime();
		var rawRunStart = sysautoGr.run_start;
		var runStart = rawRunStart.getGlideObject();
		if (runStart.getDate() == null)
			return now;

		// on insert OR if run_start is in the future, next occurrence should start on run_start
		if (sysautoGr.operation() == 'insert' || runStart.after(now))
			return runStart;

		return null;
	},

	buildTriggerGr: function(sysautoGr) {
		var triggerType = this._convertRunTypeToTriggerType(sysautoGr.getValue("run_type"));
		if (triggerType == null)
			return;

		var triggerGr = new GlideRecord("sys_trigger");
		triggerGr.setValue("trigger_type", triggerType);
		triggerGr.setValue("run_dayofweek", sysautoGr.getValue("run_dayofweek"));
		triggerGr.setValue("run_daysofweek", sysautoGr.getValue("run_daysofweek"));
		triggerGr.setValue("run_dayofmonth", sysautoGr.getValue("run_dayofmonth"));
		triggerGr.setValue("run_time", sysautoGr.getValue("run_time"));
		triggerGr.setValue("repeat", sysautoGr.getValue("run_period"));
		triggerGr.setValue("max_drift", sysautoGr.getValue("max_drift"));
		triggerGr.setValue("run_weekinmonth", sysautoGr.getValue("run_weekinmonth"));
		triggerGr.setValue("run_month", sysautoGr.getValue("run_month"));
		triggerGr.setValue("advanced", sysautoGr.getValue("advanced"));
		triggerGr.setValue("run_start", sysautoGr.getValue("run_start"));
		triggerGr.setValue("run_end", sysautoGr.getValue("run_end"));

		// for periodically/repeat jobs with run_start in the past, set the next_action to run_start
		if (triggerType == 1)
			triggerGr.setValue("next_action", sysautoGr.getValue("run_start"));

		return triggerGr;
	},

	// convert sysauto's run_type to sys_trigger's trigger_type
	_convertRunTypeToTriggerType: function(runType) {
		switch(runType) {
			case "periodically":
				return 1;
			case "weekly":
				return 3;
			case "monthly":
				return 4;
			case "week_in_month":
				return 5;
			case "day_and_month_in_year":
				return 6;
			case "day_week_month_year":
				return 7;
			case "daily":
				return 11;
			default:
				return null;
		}
    },

    type: 'AdvancedSchedulerUtils'
};]]></script>
